tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-01: Keep track of the partners each dancer has and the partner changes that occur, then determine who Alice is dancing with at the end of the dance.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-02: Determine the final partner of a specific dancer by tracing the sequence of partner switches throughout the song.

tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-05: Determine the final dance partner of a given dancer by tracking the sequence of partner switches, starting from the initial partner.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-06: Keep track of the sequence of partner changes to determine the final partner of each dancer.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-07: Keep track of the partners each dancer has after each pair of dancers switches partners.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-08: Follow the sequence of partner swaps to determine the final partner of each dancer.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-09: Determine the final partner of a given dancer by tracking the sequence of partner swaps throughout the song.
tracking_shuffled_objects_five_objects.Meta-10: Follow the sequence of partner swaps to determine the final partner of the person who was initially dancing with a given person.
